title: NYC Site Visit:
headline: A one-minute, moving-picture version of the 12 Oct funder site visit: a gym full of kids playing NBA Math Hoops, funders watching, real room sound.
story: Funders from the Grantmakers for Education conference came to see Learn Fresh. A panel first, then a mini tournament: 27 students playing NBA Math Hoops, adults learning the game and joining in.
Learn Fresh already posted a photo carousel. This is the moving version and it has to feel like more: energy, reactions, the program in action. No RCT data.
Loops: L1 “What is happening in this room?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:15. L2 “What do the kids think?” opens at 0:40 and closes at 0:50. Stakes: none needed; this is the joy piece.
do: Open cold on the room coming alive, natural sound, with the hook text already on screen.
Cut on reactions, not on explanation. Kids excited beat kids concentrating.
Show the diversity of the room: girls and boys, many tables.
Real room audio, music under, never over. The client's reference is a Save The Music piece.
End on the wide and the Donate end card.
dont: No RCT data, no statistics, no study explanation.
No school names on screen. No student last names.
Do not lean on two or three kids. Spread the coverage.
No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No end-of-year campaign words on the end card.

tech: Interview camera, 1920×1080 at 59.94 fps (from visual.json), one file per subject. Audio recorded into the camera.
Interview mic into the camera. The gym was loud: kids are audible behind every answer. Keep a little room tone, it sells the day. Level pass and light noise reduction only.
Master: 1920×1080, 16:9. Version two: 1080×1920, 9:16. Same edit, same order. Source is 59.94 fps: use a 29.97 fps timeline and interpret footage, no speed change.
Interviews are medium shots with the subject in the center: center crop. B-roll is 16:9: crop on the hands and faces (cx numbers in this plan are from small frames, check by eye).
-14 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP peak. Music always under the voice.
Pauses inside a bite longer than 0.7 s are cut to about 0.25 s. Row times in this plan count that.
Burned in, low in the frame, client font RangleRiforma Bold (brand kit in Airtable). Spell NBA Math Hoops (the auto-transcript writes “MBA”), Learn Fresh, WestEd.
